problem_type: Reasoning body rendered as fixed-height status metadata
symptom: Long reasoning overlaps user bubble, two receipts and assistant body in real Electron.
direct_cause: laneViewModel assigns part.text to thinking.meta; V4Thinking renders it in an h-7 inline-flex row with items-center and visible overflow.
class_root: The shared presentation contract does not separate unbounded reasoning content from one-line status metadata.
affected_population: Restored reasoning history in creation, generation, storyboard and preview
internal_only_reason: An internal presentation contract violation; native HTML details and existing V4ToolReceipt provide disclosure without a dependency or external format change.
invariants: Reasoning text is never status metadata.
Reasoning is collapsed by default and expansion grows the row in normal flow.
Visible text and row bounds from distinct conversation items never overlap.
generality_proof: All four resident surfaces and restored/live native lane parts converge on laneViewModel and V4FlowRow/V4Thinking; no provider or host-specific layout exceptions.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Separate reasoning body and streaming state from metadata.
Default-closed disclosure with natural block height.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: All resident surfaces project snapshot.active with laneViewModel.
Feeds native LanePart arrays through real laneClient and ProjectAgentResidentShell, including restored non-streaming thinking.

recurrence.reason: Any sufficiently long thinking paragraph overflows; independent of provider or whether restored.
same_class_scan: rg thinking src/workbench/ai/lane src/workbench/ai/v4: laneViewModel is the sole body-to-meta producer; placeholder uses empty meta.
Read ShellStage and ProjectAgentResidentShell: all four host surfaces share the renderer.
Read AgentPanelV4Panel/V4FlowRow and V4ToolReceipt: natural-flow siblings already use shrink-0; thinking h-7 is the unbounded-content mismatch.

prevention.invariant: Unbounded reasoning belongs to a default-closed natural-height body, never the status line.
prevention.failure_mode: Closed details do not paint body text; expanded details reserve full body height for subsequent rows.
prevention.strategy: Separate content from metadata at projection and enforce disclosure at the shared renderer.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace body-as-meta assignment and fixed-height outer thinking row in place; no parallel renderer.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party runtime controls the missing application-level distinction. Native details already used by receipts.

migration: No persisted or wire format changes; all historical parts project into the new presentation body automatically.
residual_risks: Persisted history contains no per-thinking duration; do not fabricate a historical timer.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Shared presentation boundary owns disclosure and row geometry; projection owns separate fields.
